title: Prior-Informed Generalizable Low-Rank Representation Learning via Regularized Adversarial Reweighting
abstract: arXiv:2610.14414v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern learning problems increasingly leverage data from heterogeneous sources to improve robustness and generalizability under distribution shift, often with high-dimensional parameters admitting low-rank structure. Existing group distributionally robust optimization (group-DRO) approaches optimize against adverse source mixtures, but extending this principle to low-rank matrix estimation with a broad class of losses leads to a challenging nonconvex-concave problem for which methods and theory remain limited. We propose Prior-Informed generalizable Low-rank representation Learning via Adversarial Reweighting (PILLAR), which smooths the group-DRO objective by regularizing adversarial source weights toward a user-specified reference distribution while learning a shared low-rank representation. By tempering extreme adversarial reweighting, PILLAR improves estimation stability and reduces the potential conservativeness of group-DRO. Using

translated_title: 通过先验信息与正则化对抗重加权实现可泛化的低秩表示学习
translated_abstract: 现代学习问题日益利用来自异构数据源的信息，以提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，这通常涉及具有低秩结构的高维参数。现有的组分布鲁棒优化方法针对不利的源数据混合比例进行优化，但将这一原则扩展到适用于广泛损失类别的低秩矩阵估计时，会产生一个具有挑战性的非凸-凹优化问题，目前针对该问题的方法与理论仍然有限。我们提出了PILLAR（基于先验信息的可泛化低秩表示学习与对抗重加权方法），该方法在学习共享低秩表示的同时，通过将对抗性源权重向用户指定的参考分布正则化，从而平滑组分布鲁棒优化目标。通过缓和极端的对抗重加权，PILLAR 提升了估计的稳定性，并降低了组分布鲁棒优化方法潜在的过度保守性。
tldr: 提出 PILLAR 方法，通过将对抗性源权重向用户指定的先验参考分布正则化来平滑组分布鲁棒优化目标，在学习共享低秩表示的同时提升估计稳定性并缓解过度保守性，从而实现分布偏移下更可泛化的低秩表示学习。
en_tdlr: PILLAR smooths the group-DRO objective by regularizing adversarial source weights toward a user-specified prior distribution, enabling stable and generalizable low-rank representation learning under distribution shift while mitigating the over-conservativeness of standard group-DRO.
